scope: Frontend presentation only; no ERPBridge, RAG, pipeline or backend permission changes
features: Acknowledged approval/rejection closes the inline review; completed runs no longer keep consumed review banners in chat or canvas
An unknown acknowledgement does not count as a decision; original review evidence and execution history remain available
Each new checkpoint resets the prior decision display and requests fresh review
Display-only Inputs & documents entry precedes ERP nodes when the workflow declares inputs
Clicking that entry opens document uploads and required fields inside the canvas, not in the chat header or a page-wide modal
Canvas preparation reuses existing validation, source confirmation, missing-field blocking and explicit Start; it does not change saved ERP steps
Original-run recovery is available inside the canvas panel when a previous admission must be reviewed

automatedChecks.note: Final repeat after adding canvas recovery; counts overlap

liveChecks: Deployed completed run shows Results DONE without consumed review banners in chat or canvas
First Inputs & documents canvas entry opens the Canvas workflow inputs region without a page-wide modal
Four required item fields are displayed; typing an item code removes only its missing-field error
Image chooser accepts item-complete.png inside the canvas and enables Read document
Missing fields keep Start workflow disabled; no workflow was started or ERP record created during this check
Close canvas inputs returns to the graph and preserves the three saved ERP steps
